notes: Explicit, hash-gated decisions only. No general heuristic. If a legacy file's current SHA-256 does not match source_sha256 here, no entry applies and the file uses exactly the existing safeguards (Media::file_valid()). Entries added under Q05 extend this SAME model to 32 additional files identified in the FULL DRY RUN's 1,949/932 REVIEW review: 11 are byte-identical twins of an already-approved file at a different legacy path (same content reached via both the static page path and the SQL-derived system/files/images/productos/<hash> path for the same product; PdfApprovals::resolve() matches legacy_path+hash exactly, so a twin needs its own entry even though it shares source_sha256 with an existing one). 9 have a real declared /OpenAction (/S /GoTo) that a full pikepdf object-graph walk proved targets a /Page object inside the SAME document (never remote, never /Launch, /URI, /JavaScript, /SubmitForm, /ImportData, /GoToR, /GoToE, /Sound, /Movie, /Rendition or /Hide anywhere in the file) -- classified SAFE_PDF_BENIGN_INTERNAL_ACTION, distinct from a pure regex coincidence. 11 are pure regex false positives (no /EmbeddedFile, /OpenAction, /AA, /Names/JavaScript anywhere), same class as the original Group B. 1 file (puerta-thermacore-595.pdf) has the same benign-/EmbeddedFile profile as the original Group A but new content, and required its own sanitization run.
